## Contact Form to GHL CRM sync and Lead Routing by JEV, and creating oppurtunities in CRM and notify sales and opporational teams

### How it works

This workflow receives contact form submissions, validates that an email is present, and synchronizes the person with GoHighLevel CRM. It checks whether the contact already exists, upserts new or missing contact data when needed, then calls the JEV routing API to decide which downstream path to use. Based on the route, it evaluates existing CRM opportunities, creates or pushes the lead into the appropriate pipeline, and notifies the relevant Slack channel for sales or partnership/operations follow-up.

### Setup steps

- Configure the n8n form trigger fields so submissions include the expected contact details, especially email.
- Connect and authorize the GoHighLevel credentials used by the contact, opportunity fetch, and pipeline creation/update nodes.
- Verify the JEV routing HTTP endpoint and any required API headers or authentication for https://api.beatapi.io/v1/systemone.
- Configure the Switch node rules so JEV routing responses map correctly to the sales and partnership/opportunity branches.
- Connect Slack credentials and set the correct destination channels for the sales team and partnership/operations team notifications.

### Customization

Adjust the opportunity categorization code, pipeline IDs/stages, Slack message templates, and Switch routing conditions to match your CRM structure and team routing rules.

@[youtube](dmzbxqZRGxs)

## Receive and validate form

Starts the workflow from a contact form submission and checks that an email address was provided before attempting CRM lookup.

## Resolve CRM contact

Looks up the submitted contact in GoHighLevel, determines whether a matching contact exists, and upserts contact details when needed.

## Route lead by JEV

Sends the lead details to the JEV routing API and uses the returned result to split the workflow into the correct downstream path.

## Evaluate sales opportunities

Top branch that fetches GoHighLevel opportunities, categorizes them, and checks whether the lead should be pushed into the sales pipeline.

## Evaluate partnership opportunities

Bottom branch that fetches GoHighLevel opportunities, categorizes them, and checks whether the lead should be pushed into the partnership or opportunity pipeline.

## Create sales follow-up

Creates or updates the lead in the sales pipeline, generates a Slack notification message, and sends it to the sales team channel.

## Create partnership follow-up

Creates or updates the lead in the opportunity/partnership pipeline, prepares the Slack message, and notifies the partnership channel.
